第3章趋吉避凶大明王焱天大圣
“人无绝境？这陆景倒是乐观。”
明月亭中，隔着极远的距离，盛姿都清楚的听到了陆景轻语。
习武者，自有不同。
陆景根本无法看清明月亭中的两道身影是谁，但盛姿却可以隐约听到陆景的呢喃声。
“我那里还有酥香斋出品的桃花酥，已经派人去拿了。”
陆漪正坐在软垫上，为自己倒茶。
亭中的桌案上，摆放着许多玉碟，玉碟中的菜肴各自不同，色香味俱全。
“据说酥香斋的桃花酥，桃花用料来自桃山，只有桃山上的桃树才能终年花开，只是桃山上的守山道人脾气古怪，不准人上山游玩，更不准人采摘桃花。
酥香斋不知用了什么办法，竟然能够摘来桃山上的桃花。”
陆漪语气里不无炫耀：“这桃花酥数量有限，因为老太君与酥香斋有旧，才能在每月分到十盒，再分下来，每月分到我手里的，也就两块，今日你来了，我才愿意拿出来招待你。”
盛姿转头，看到桌上琳琅满目的美食佳肴。
方才两人已经用过饭食了，这桌上剩下的饭菜还能够四五个大汉饱餐一顿。
“九湖陆府即使不复之前的荣光，神霄将军又被贬谪，却依然称得上白玉为堂金作马，奢靡无比。”
盛姿在心中叹息，又看向远处石桌上的陆景：“只是这样的豪族，却容不下一个庶子。”
“也许等到神霄将军归来，知道是陆景牺牲，沦为赘婿才让他得以归京，陆景的处境才能好上一些。”
盛姿不作声，陆漪循着她的目光看去，又隐隐约约看到假山中的陆景。
“咦，那是陆景吗？他竟然还在读书？”
盛姿摇了摇头，走出明月亭：“走吧，去其它地方逛一逛吧。”
陆漪顾不得陆景：“盛姿，你真的不想尝一尝那桃花酥吗？”

“不了，我吃腻了。”
一盏油灯本来无法照出明亮的光芒，供陆景读书。
可不知是不是陆景运气好，今夜的月光显得尤为清澈透亮，天空中也并无云雾遮挡，直落在地面上，让陆景不至于看的太艰难。
已是亥时。
陆景正在细细宫阙一般的金色命格，终于又突兀的闪过几道金光。
【事毕，吉！】
随着这道信息流入陆景的脑海。
陆景隐约感知到自己那【趋吉避凶命格】中，一幅古朴的八卦图悬浮其上，那八卦图中，竟还有自己的倒影。
图上的八卦缓缓旋转，最终显示出一幅上卦卦象！
“九五：飞龙在天，利见大人。”
“这句经文有许多意思，这里大约是指龙星出现在天上，对王公贵族有利。”
“所谓大人，在这里，指的是我本身。”
陆景看到卦象，不由解读出其中的含义：“这是上卦，也是吉卦。”
他思绪刚刚落下，那八卦图中，又有一道道白色的光芒飞出，落在【趋吉避凶命格】的一旁，交织起来，化作另外一道命格天赋！
【九五：飞龙在天，利见大人！
吉，获命格：勤勉刻苦（白）！】
【首次触发趋吉避凶命格，获得一道蓝色机缘！】
【命格—勤勉刻苦（白）：
【获得一道蓝色机缘，正在触发。】
“这白色的【勤勉刻苦】是新的命格，来自于炽金色的【趋吉避凶】？这样看来，颜色应当代表着命格的等级。”

“【趋吉避凶】命格之下，选择合适的吉凶之象，竟能有此收获。”
陆景虽然心里好奇这些信息，但他仍然读完了眼前书页上的最后一段，读完了那一则“善妖寄居水缸里，每日爬出水缸，为屠户讲道”的故事之后，这才深吸一口气，将这本书放在桌上，闭起眼睛。
其他人看他，约莫会觉得是他读书太过疲累，正在闭目休憩。
可陆景闭目之时，却又清楚的看到黑暗中，悬浮起那一幅八卦图。
也清楚的看到八卦图中，自己的倒影。
少年青衫，面色苍白，看起来有些斯文，当眼神却十分沉静。
“【命格八卦图】……可观自身内外之象……”
“这文弱少年是我的外象，那我的内象……”
随着陆景思绪及此。
又有种种信息流入陆景的脑海里。
【陆景内象：
命格：周易—趋吉避凶（炽金）、勤勉刻苦（白）
机缘：蓝色机缘正在触发
功：无】
“这‘境’与‘功’又是什么？”
陆景皱眉。
他穿越过来之后，原身的记忆就一直有些模糊，很多记忆就好像是蒙了一层细纱，无法轻易想起。
可是当他朝着某些线索努力回想时，却仍有收获。
“依稀记得，小时候曾经误入府里的武典阁，在一本书上，看到过类似的描述。”
“武道一途，以体为表，以元驱之，蕴养自身，再甚者，以儒道佛为舟，分九品之境，修天下之真，渡无界苦海。”

“所谓境、功，大概就是指境界、功法。”
陆景心里叹了一口气。
九湖陆家也是武勋世家。
过往两百年，大伏越发强大，周遭的外族或亡国灭族，或向大伏俯首称臣，每年都要进献岁银。
近百年，大伏似乎已经强大如天威，不可悖逆，边境百族越发恐惧大伏，正因为有如此浩荡威严，战事也越来越少。
这也导致勋贵存于安乐之中，实力渐弱，声威也一年不如一年，
百年前，九湖陆家传侯爵，然而经历许多变故之后，如今的九湖陆家只能传伯爵。
曾经赫赫有名的神霄爵位，也逐渐被神霄将军这一实职盖过了锋芒。
“可哪怕如此，武勋世家子弟，自然都是人人习武的，原身已经十六岁，却还不能入武典阁，没有武者教授骑、射、剑，由此可见，这原身在陆家根本就等同于一个外人。”
陆景叹了一口气：“我现在占据了他的躯体，能够重活一遭，却也面临着他的困境。”
薄云掠过了月亮，遮住了月光。
被皎洁月光遮掩的漫天星光显露出踪迹。
此时一阵风吹过。
陆景还在思索。
眼前的《知慎》突然间被这风吹的翻页，陆景正要按住这本已然有些念头的书，却见风过之后，摊开的书页中，竟然掉出了一幅图画。
陆景好奇的从地上捡起泛着光芒的金黄色画纸。
画纸极薄，原本对折，他随意
那神明盘坐在黑色莲花宝座上，一手抬前摊开，拇指和食指轻轻接触，做出一个“佛菩萨印”。
另一只手则平举在胸前，手中托举着一团焰火。
怪异得是，那神明明端坐佛莲，手捏佛印，但却梳着道髻，穿着赤红色道袍，道袍衣袖之间还绣着一种卦象！

“这是佛？是道？是妖？还是神？”
陆景心中好奇，画像的左边，还有一行小字。
——【大明王焱天大圣神明图】！
他之所以还揣测这画像神明有可能是妖，原因也十分简单。
因为这画像上的神明虽然样貌威严、怒目前视，身后却又有一对肉翼，额头也也长着第三只眼睛！
此时祂第三目闭起，却隐隐有光芒涌现出来！
“名为神明图，其上画着的所谓神明，却兼具了佛道妖的特点，倒也古怪。”
陆景端详了这幅图画许久，越发觉得这幅神明图绘得十分精巧，便打算收起来。
可就在此时，原本被薄云遮住的月亮，从那云中探出头来，照耀下一缕月光，正好落在被陆景摊在桌上的神明图上。
下一瞬间，那怪异神明左手上，原本被画出来的光团，竟然真的开始发光。
陆景还没有反应过来，就有一道光芒从中直射而出，落入陆景的眼中！
“嗯？”
光芒入目，陆景终于意识到……
这莫非就是他刚刚因为首次触发了【趋吉避凶】命格，而获得那一道蓝色机缘？
content_en:
Chapter 3 Seeking good fortune and avoiding misfortune, Ming Dynasty King Yantian
"No one is in desperate situation? Lu Jing is optimistic."
In the Mingyue Pavilion, Shengzi clearly heard Lu Jing's whisper from a very far distance away.
Martial arts practitioners are different.
Lu Jing couldn't see clearly who the two figures in the Mingyue Pavilion were, but Shengzi could vaguely hear Lu Jing's murmur.
"I still have peach blossom cakes produced by Suxiangzhai, and I have sent someone to get them."
Lu Yi was sitting on the soft cushion, pouring tea for herself.
There are many jade plates placed on the table in the pavilion. The dishes on the jade plates are different and full of color, fragrance and flavor.
"It is said that the peach blossoms of Suxiangzhai's peach blossom cakes come from Taoshan. Only the peach trees on Taoshan can bloom all year round. However, the Taoist priest on Taoshan has a weird temper and does not allow people to go to the mountain to play, let alone pick peach blossoms.
I don't know what method Suxiangzhai used to pick peach blossoms from Peach Mountain. "
Lu Yi said in a boastful tone: "The quantity of these peach blossom cakes is limited. Because the old lady has an old relationship with Suxiangzhai, she can only distribute ten boxes every month. After that, I will only get two pieces every month. Since you are here today, I am willing to take them out to entertain you."
Shengzi turned around and saw the dazzling array of delicacies on the table.
The two of them had already eaten, and the food left on the table could still feed four or five big men.
"Even though the Jiuhu Lu Mansion has lost its former glory and General Shenxiao has been demoted, it is still worthy of the title of White Jade, and is extremely extravagant."
Sheng Zi sighed in her heart and looked at Lu Jing on the stone table in the distance: "It's just that such a wealthy family cannot tolerate a bastard."
"Perhaps when General Shenxiao returns and finds out that Lu Jing sacrificed his life and became a son-in-law so that he could return to the capital, Lu Jing's situation will be better."
Sheng Zi remained silent, Lu Yi followed her gaze and vaguely saw Lu Jing in the rockery.
"Hey, is that Lu Jing? He is still studying?"
Shengzi shook her head and walked out of Mingyue Pavilion: "Let's go and go shopping elsewhere."
Lu Yi ignored Lu Jing: "Shengzi, don't you really want to try that peach blossom cake?"
"No, I'm tired of it."
An oil lamp originally could not shine bright light for Lu Jing to study.
But I wonder if Lu Jing is lucky. The moonlight tonight is particularly clear and bright. There are no clouds and fog in the sky. It falls directly on the ground, so Lu Jing won't have a hard time seeing it.
It's Haishi.
Lu Jing was studying the palace-like golden destiny, and finally a few golden lights flashed suddenly.
[It’s over, good luck! 】
As this piece of information flowed into Lu Jing's mind.
Lu Jing vaguely sensed that a simple Bagua picture was suspended above his [Destiny Pattern of Seeking Good Luck and Avoiding Misfortune], and there was actually his own reflection in the Bagua Picture.
The Bagua on the picture slowly rotates, finally showing a picture of the upper hexagram!
"Nine-five: The flying dragon is in the sky, which is a good way to meet the adults."
"This verse has many meanings. It probably refers to the appearance of the dragon star in the sky, which is beneficial to the kings and nobles."
"The so-called adults here refer to myself."
When Lu Jing saw the hexagram, he couldn't help but interpret its meaning: "This is the upper hexagram, and it is also a good hexagram."
As soon as he finished his thoughts, white rays of light flew out from the Bagua chart, falling on the side of the [Fate of Seeking Good Luck and Avoiding Misfortune], intertwining and turning into another talent of destiny!
[Ninety-five: The flying dragon is in the sky, it’s good to see you!
Ji, the destiny pattern: Diligent and hardworking (white)! 】
[Trigger the destiny pattern of seeking good luck and avoiding evil for the first time, and get a blue opportunity! 】
[Destiny—Diligence and Hardworking (White):
[Obtained a blue opportunity, triggering. 】
"This white [diligence and hard work] is the new destiny, coming from the blazing golden [seeking good luck and avoiding misfortune]? From this point of view, the color should represent the level of destiny."
"[Seek good fortune and avoid misfortune] Under the destiny, if you choose the appropriate signs of good and bad luck, you can actually achieve this."
Lu JingjingAlthough he was curious about this information, he still read the last paragraph on the page in front of him. After reading the story about "a good demon lives in a water tank and climbs out of the water tank every day to preach to the butcher", he took a deep breath, put the book on the table, and closed his eyes.
When other people look at him, they may think that he is too tired from studying and is taking a rest with his eyes closed.
But when Lu Jing closed his eyes, he could clearly see the Bagua picture floating in the darkness.
He also clearly saw his own reflection in the Bagua diagram.
The young man in green shirt has a pale face and looks a little gentle, but his eyes are very calm.
"[Fate Bagua Chart]...you can see the internal and external phenomena of yourself..."
"This frail boy is my outer appearance, but my inner image..."
As Lu Jing's thoughts continued.
All kinds of information flowed into Lu Jing's mind.
[Internal image of Lu Jing:
Fortune: Zhouyi - seek good luck and avoid bad luck (blazing gold), be diligent and hardworking (white)
Opportunity: The blue opportunity is triggering
Gong: None]
"What are these 'realm' and 'gong'?"
Lu Jing frowned.
After he traveled through time, his original memory has been a little blurry. Many memories seem to be covered with a thin veil and cannot be easily recalled.
But when he tried to recall certain clues, he still gained something.
"I vaguely remember that when I was a child, I accidentally entered the Wudi Pavilion in the mansion and saw a similar description in a book."
"The way of martial arts is to use the body as the surface, use the Yuan to drive it, and nourish oneself. What's more, use Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism as the boat, divide the realm into nine levels, cultivate the truth of the world, and cross the boundless sea of suffering."
"The so-called realm and skill probably refer to realm and skill."
Lu Jing sighed inwardly.
The Jiuhu Lu family is also a martial arts family.
In the past two hundred years, Dafu has become more and more powerful. The surrounding foreigners have either lost their country or genocide, or surrendered to Dafu, and they have to contribute silver every year.
In the past hundred years, Dafu seems to have become as powerful as the power of heaven and irresistible. The tribes on the border have become more and more afraid of Dafu. Because of such majesty and majesty, there have been fewer and fewer wars.
This also caused the nobles to live in peace and contentment, their strength gradually weakened, and their prestige became worse year by year.
A hundred years ago, the Lu family in Jiuhu passed down the line to a marquis. However, after many changes, the Lu family in Jiuhu now can only pass down a count.
The once famous title of Shenxiao has gradually been overshadowed by the actual position of General Shenxiao.
"But even so, all the children of the Wuxun family naturally practice martial arts. The original person is already sixteen years old, but he is not yet allowed to enter the Wudi Pavilion. There are no martial artists to teach riding, archery, and swordsmanship. It can be seen that the original person is basically equivalent to an outsider in the Lu family."
Lu Jing sighed: "Now that I have taken over his body, I can live again, but I am also facing his dilemma."
Thin clouds passed over the moon, blocking the moonlight.
The starry sky covered by the bright moonlight revealed traces.
At this time a gust of wind blew.
Lu Jing was still thinking.
The pages of "Zhi Shen" in front of him were suddenly blown by the wind. Lu Jing was about to hold down the book that had some thoughts in it, but he saw that after the wind passed by, a picture fell out of the open pages.
Lu Jing curiously picked up the glowing golden drawing paper from the ground.
The drawing paper was extremely thin. It was originally folded in half, but he randomly
The god was sitting cross-legged on a black lotus throne, with one hand spread out in front of him, his thumb and index finger touching lightly, making a "Buddha and Bodhisattva seal".
The other hand was raised flat on his chest, holding a firework in his hand.
What's weird is that the god is clearly sitting on the Buddha lotus, holding the Buddha's seal with his hand, but he is wearing a Taoist bun and a red Taoist robe, with a hexagram embroidered between the sleeves of the Taoist robe!
"Is this Buddha? Is it Tao? Is it a demon? Or a god?"
Lu Jing was curious. There was a line of small words on the left side of the portrait.
——[Picture of the Ming Dynasty’s Great Sage Yantian]!
The reason why he speculated that the god in the portrait might be a demon was very simple.
Because although the god in this portrait looks majestic and glares angrily, behind himThere is another pair of flesh wings, and there is also a third eye on the forehead!
At this time, His third eye was closed, but a faint light emerged!
"It's called the God Picture. The so-called gods painted on it have the characteristics of Buddhism, Taoism and demons, which is quite strange."
Lu Jing looked at the picture for a long time, and felt more and more that this picture of a god was very delicately drawn, so he decided to put it away.
But at this moment, the moon, which was originally covered by thin clouds, poked its head out from the clouds, shining a ray of moonlight, which happened to fall on the picture of gods spread out on the table by Lu Jing.
The next moment, the light group that was originally drawn on the left hand of the weird god actually started to glow.
Before Lu Jing could react, a ray of light shot straight out and fell into Lu Jing's eyes!
"Huh?"
As the light entered his eyes, Lu Jing finally realized...
Could this be the blue opportunity he just received because he triggered the [Seeking Good Luck and Avoiding Disaster] destiny for the first time?
